entry.limits: Remote PR scope includes open and closed/merged titles and bodies, with separate coverage and timestamps. State changes are deduplicated by latest PR update; snapshots are not atomic. nearest.relationship: Binary complete common-image family of independent rows. Its third open question explicitly asks about odd fields/restricted headers. The affine-pencil dependency orbit and multiway sign crossings are outside that proof.
Proves the all-field positive pair sign from PR4807. Every pair here is a transpose-dual control; its binary sign and higher-way extension are not attributed to this package.
Nick Petalas derived the all-field common-covector pair law and binary positive sign.
Corank-one marginal. The present single-guard formula reproduces that prior result.
Laminar projectors with nested or orthogonal children; a pencil of distinct common-image kernels does not satisfy those hypotheses.
Two commuting rank-two ternary requests and their first two minors, a different pair orbit.
General ordered-pair orbit weights; the present denominator fixes an entire common-image list and counts the passing prefixes.
Orthogonal family of full guards, a different multiplication/row dependency.
Opened coupled-versus-orthogonal questions. One coupled pair among four otherwise orthogonal kernels is distinct.
Previous contribution from this account classifies signatures of bases split into two port blocks. Neither its branch nor its result supplies this guard law.
